messages:
jin: fyi — customer onboarding hit duplicates in our Node + Python sampleapps when they saw intermittent 429s during initial burst. reproducer attached in GH issue.

ara: thanks. is this more of a server dedupe gap or SDK retry behavior mismatch across languages?

jin: bit of both. summary: Node SDK retries immediately after refresh promise triggers, python retries await refresh, but neither ran idempotency by default in sampleapps. node path ends up sending two creates.

peter: can you paste the short log sequence?

jin: sure:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z client: POST /v1/jobs -> 429 rate_limited
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z node-sdk: start token refresh (async)
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z node-sdk: retry POST (no idempotency) -> 201 created
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z server: processed job A
2026-03-15T14:12:04Z refresh: completed
2026-03-15T14:12:04Z original caller: retry resolves -> 201 created
2026-03-15T14:12:04Z server: processed job B
```

ara: oh, so two different code-paths cause two distinct requests. Python waited on refresh so only one went through?

jin: python sampleapp had a single in-flight refresh promise + retry gate. node sampleapp didn't.

peter: mitigation options (short): 1) sampleapps should set X-Idempotency-Key for POSTs, 2) SDKs should expose a "awaitRefresh" hook or internally gate retries until refresh completes, 3) change default retry/jitter policy to reduce collision window.

ara: on auto-gen idempotency keys: i'm hesitant to make it on by default in SDKs. it changes API semantics for users who expect multiple creates. but sampleapps and onboarding should enable a protective mode. maybe SDKs offer "autoIdempotency: 'opt-in'" config and sampleapps enable it.

jin: agreed. sampleapps should default to safe patterns. i'll update both Node and Python starters. also adding a prominent note in README about idempotency and token refresh races.

peter: for backoff defaults proposal: base 1.5s, multiplier 2.0, max 12s, jitter 30%, retries=3 for 429/5xx. let's keep these conservative for onboarding templates.

ara: add a quick signal to telemetry: tag retries that occurred during token refresh so we can see incidence. then we can tune SDK heuristics if common.

qa-bot: opened integration test issue: https://git.redwood/tests/issue/1345 - tests to simulate 429 at t=0 + refresh delays.

sdk-ci: Node SDK MR created: https://git.redwood/sdks/mr/923 (adds retry-gate + opt-in auto-idempotency). Python MR: https://git.redwood/sdks/mr/924 (docs + sampleapp changes).

jin: nice. i'm going to patch the onboarding checklist: "enable safe_replay_protection in sampleapps" + short code example. also will include a snippet for single-refresh promise pattern.

ara: can we add a short lint rule in sampleapp repo that flags POSTs without X-Idempotency-Key in the example code? would catch future regressions in examples.

peter: good idea. add it to the build step and make it a warning for now.

jin: thanks team — once PRs land i'll draft a short migration note for customers who might see duplicate jobs and include rollback steps (delete dup jobs or ignore duplicates on consumer side). :thumbsup:
